pipeline: Generate transparent original -> upload full original to existing Figma file -> native clipping components -> Figma PNG exports -> runtime; no raster redraw by code
promptBrief: Production orthographic transparent candy factory atlas: ivory enamel, mint machines, subtle gold trim, upper-left studio light. 2x2 isolated elements: top-left horizontal dark teal conveyor with cream rails, top-right filling bridge with eight dispensing mouths, bottom-left open canister with short bottom spout, bottom-right lift gate. No text/candy/characters/logos/scene background. Exact 1536x1024 landscape; intended for raster game component composition.

assets.promptBrief: Single perfectly overhead continuous racetrack oval candy conveyor, dark teal tread, cream enamel and gold rails, transparent center and exterior, empty tread, no candy/text/arrows/environment. Polished tactile mint candy factory style, upper-left light.

usage.belt: Horizontal belt; preserve rails and alpha; use belt-tile for loop tread. Rotate complete sprite 90deg for vertical belt.
usage.bridge: Horizontal filling bridge. Mouths face lower image edge; align actual filling targets immediately below mouths.
usage.hopper: Canister cavity centered near 50%,40%; outflow at lower edge. Overlay existing colored candy sprite; never recolor the whole bitmap.
usage.gate: Use above belt; lift bar only when batch is released. Keep gate movement separate from target selection.
usage.perspective: Straight overhead motif, softly modelled shallow sides. Reuse existing 256px candy/socket identical geometry.
usage.loop: Continuous oval belt; original image tread center roughly x105..1675/y185..675; scale and animate candy centers along its visible actual tread, not through center hole. Source original is the runtime PNG.
usage.variableBridge: Use beam plus one nozzle per target column. Repeat registered raster nozzle; scale uniformly to about0.72 cell width. Candy starts at nozzle center x50%,y89% and lands into aligned socket. Retain old eight-mouth bridge only for historical or fixed-eight layouts.

qa.compositionReview: Passed final real-browser composition review: bridge level 8 at 320/390/430px, trays and loop level 8 at 390px. Dense packet quantity and flavor labels are separated; the 320px toolbar follows the third packet row without overlap. B conveyor label contrast and C gate bounds pass. Candy/socket/giftbox bitmap combinations remain coherent. This is screenshot and layout evidence, not owner playtest, real-device validation or animation acceptance.
qa.shortViewportBehavior: At 320x680 the full document is 779px high; stock ends at y707 and toolbar starts y715. Natural page scrolling is intentional, without overlapping fixed controls.

additionalSources.promptBrief: Transparent overhead 2-part candy factory atlas. Top: long glossy mint/ivory/gold gantry beam with blank continuous lower rail, absolutely no built-in nozzles. Bottom: one individual matching mint/gold dispensing nozzle with dark circular downward opening. Soft upper-left light, no candy/text/environment. Game repeats nozzle per target column.
